issues.description: The problem statement requires a public method named checkOrderReady() on SealSaloon (UML and textual description). The reference implementation instead provides a method named processOrders() that implements the described behavior and is invoked from orderMeal(). This naming mismatch between the specification and the solution can confuse students about which method name to implement and call (the UML and text explicitly mention checkOrderReady).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the names consistent: either rename the solution method processOrders() to checkOrderReady() (and have orderMeal call checkOrderReady()), or update the problem statement/UML to use processOrders() instead of checkOrderReady(). Ensure the public method name in the specification matches the implementation expected from students.
